grounding.states: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina

value.answer: Messi, for me. He's been elite at the top level for about two decades, and he finally won the World Cup with Argentina in 2022, which is the one thing that was missing from his résumé. Pelé is the other name people always bring up, but Messi's consistency across so many years and leagues is hard to beat.
